title: Systematic Literature Review about Software for References Extraction
author: Alessia Cioffi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.buz9nx96

steps.title: Prepare Research Tracking Materials
steps.instruction: Create the necessary digital files to track retrieved papers and software, using a table format for all.

substeps.instruction: Create 'Papers_to_analyze' file: An intermediate 8-column table (Title, DOI/Link, Author(s), Publication Date, Venue, Volume, Issue, Pages).
Create 'Papers_to_keep' file: An 8-column table for papers compliant with General IC and screening IC.
Create 'Papers_to_discard' file: An 8-column table for papers not meeting IC requirements.
Create 'Papers' file: A 3-column table (Title, Topic, Relevant software, Other software) for articles passing full-text analysis.
Create 'Software' file: A 2-column table (Name, Repository link, Validity status) to collect and classify software.

steps.title: Perform Seed Paper Search
steps.instruction: Iteratively retrieve papers starting from a predefined list of seed papers.

substeps.instruction: Analyze each paper in the 'Seed papers list': if it meets General IC for papers, add to 'Papers_to_analyze'; otherwise, add to 'Papers_to_discard'.

Process 'Papers_to_analyze' iteratively: check title, keywords, and abstract. If it meets IC for screening, move to 'Papers_to_keep' and perform backward/forward searches; otherwise, move to 'Papers_to_discard'.
Perform Backward Search: Identify cited articles in the reference list; if not already tracked and meeting General IC, add to 'Papers_to_analyze'.
Perform Forward Search: Use manual methods or open platforms to find citing articles; if not already tracked and meeting General IC, add to 'Papers_to_analyze'.
Repeat until no new articles are retrieved or 'Papers_to_analyze' is empty.

steps.title: Perform Keyword-Based Search
steps.instruction: Search open research platforms using a keyword list to fill gaps left by the seed paper search.

substeps.instruction: Search each platform listed in 'Free open platforms' using all keywords from the 'Keywords list'.
Limit results to a maximum of 20 pages (Google Scholar) or 200 results per keyword.
For each retrieved article: if the title is not already in 'Papers_to_keep', 'Papers_to_discard', or 'Papers_to_analyze' and meets General IC, add to 'Papers_to_analyze'.
Iteratively process 'Papers_to_analyze' using the same analysis, backward search, and forward search logic used in the seed paper step.
Update the 'Keywords list' if new software or methodologies are discovered during reading.

steps.title: Accelerate Rejection Process (Optional)
steps.instruction: Use automated keyword filtering to quickly discard irrelevant papers when 'Papers_to_analyze' exceeds ~300 entries.

substeps.instruction: Use Crossref API to check abstracts for inclusion keywords: 'reference', 'references', 'reference strings', 'bibliographic', 'bibliography', 'citation', 'citations', 'extract', 'extraction', 'extractions', 'mining', 'mine', 'retrieve', 'CERMINE', 'GROBID', 'ParsCit'. If found, keep in 'Papers_to_analyze'; otherwise, move to 'Papers_to_discard'.
Discard papers containing exclusion keywords in the title: 'knowledge', 'semantic', 'keyword', 'covid', 'measur'.

steps.title: Conduct Quality Assessment via Full-Text Reading
steps.instruction: Read the full text of all papers in 'Papers_to_keep' to extract software and determine validity.

substeps.instruction: Discard paper: If it fails IC for papers full text, move from 'Papers_to_keep' to 'Papers_to_discard'.

Identify Invalid Software: If the paper meets the second point of IC for papers full text, add to 'Papers' file and add software to 'Software' file with status 'invalid' (e.g., unavailable, incompatible, or paid).

Identify Valid Software: If the paper meets the first point of IC for papers full text, add to 'Papers' file and add software to 'Software' file with status 'valid' (available, compatible with major OS, and free/open source).

steps.title: Finalize Literature Review
steps.instruction: Verify if all software information is complete; if gaps exist, return to the keyword search step.

substeps.instruction: Check if any software requires more information. If so, repeat keyword search for that specific software/concept.
Once complete, finalize the three output files: 'Papers_to_keep', 'Papers', and 'Software'.
